css: @page{size:250mm 45mm;margin:2mm}body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000}.tag{width:246mm;height:41mm;border:1mm solid #000;box-sizing:border-box;padding:1.5mm;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.tag-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1mm solid #000;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;padding-bottom:1mm}.type{background:#000;color:#fff;padding:1mm 4mm;letter-spacing:1px}.seq{padding:1mm 3mm;border:1px solid #000;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#fff 2mm,#ddd 2mm,#ddd 3mm)}.tag-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 30mm;gap:2mm}.identity{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38mm 48mm 1fr 34mm;grid-template-rows:8mm 7mm 7mm;align-items:center}.label{font-size:8px;font-weight:700}.hu{font-size:17px;font-weight:900}.item{font-size:16px;font-weight:900}.desc{font-size:10px}.qty{grid-column:4;grid-row:1/3;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;text-align:right}.count{grid-column:1/5;font-size:8px}.qr{text-align:center;font-size:4px;word-break:break-all}.qr img{width:23mm;height:23mm}.route{position:absolute;left:2mm;bottom:10mm;width:150mm;display:grid;grid-template-columns:38mm 45mm 8mm 55mm;align-items:center;border:1px solid #000;padding:1mm;text-align:center}.route span{font-size:6px;display:block}.route b{font-size:9px}.arrow{font-size:17px;font-weight:900}.refs{position:absolute;left:155mm;right:2mm;bottom:14mm;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;font-size:6px}.barcode{position:absolute;left:155mm;width:62mm;bottom:2mm;height:12mm}.barcode svg{width:100%;height:100%}.printed{position:absolute;right:2mm;bottom:7mm;font-size:5px}.void{position:absolute;right:2mm;bottom:2mm;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;border:1px solid #000;padding:.5mm 2mm;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#fff 1mm,#ddd 1mm,#ddd 2mm)}
